should_trigger: Give my AI agent setup a security checkup. I use Claude Code and Cursor and have a bunch of plugins installed.
I just installed a few skills from GitHub. Can you check how safe my whole agent environment is and give me a report I can share with my team?
should_not_trigger: Run a health check on our Kubernetes cluster and grade each node.
Review this one MCP server's source code for injection bugs.
expected_behaviors: runs scripts/checkup.py by full path and writes an HTML report outside the skill folder
states the grade and the one or two things that drive it before listing details
lists at most three top risks in plain language with where each one is
never prints secret values; names only the location of any leaked credential
does not change configuration or remove packages without the user's approval
says the score is heuristic and point-in-time, not a certification
